free_tier.stated: No free tier and no credit on the compute page: every rate is per GPU-hour, prepaid for a whole term, on complete 8-GPU HGX nodes with a one-node minimum. B200 USD 4.32 per GPU-hour on a 12-month term, against USD 5.40 on 1 month and USD 3.42 on 36 months; B300 USD 4.95 on 12 months and USD 5.40 on 1 month. H100, A100 80 GB, L40S and L4: not listed; RTX 4090: not listed.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.tooling: the provider description states it offers 'a range of AI models accessible via a single API key, billed on a pay-per-token basis or through long-term reservations'
record.chaining: USD 4.32 per GPU-hour for a B200 with 180 GB is the cheapest Blackwell rate among evaluated providers, and it is also the least reachable: the commitment is twelve months on eight cards. An 8x B200 node at that rate is the machine for a training run that will not fit on a rented 48 GB card, not a machine for a single inference job, and the pay-per-token API on the same provider is the row to price for the small job.
record.limits_note: no transfer quota is stated. The binding term is the commitment: one 8-GPU HGX node minimum, prepaid for the whole term on a 730 hour per GPU per month basis, and the 1, 3 and 6 month rows are sold out, so the shortest term on offer is 12 months at USD 4.32 a GPU-hour for a B200.
record.binding_note: the commitment binds: a whole-term prepayment on at least eight cards, USD 302,746 upfront for a 12-month B200 node, in place of any quota the page states.
